laws.rule: At Potrero de Yala Provincial Park, Resolution 101-SBDS/2025 requires visitors to register and prohibits lighting fires outside permitted areas. Confirm current access arrangements with park authorities.
At Potrero de Yala Provincial Park, Resolution 101-SBDS/2025 prohibits swimming and boating in the lagoons, including kayaks and canoes.

Potrero de Yala Provincial Park regulation permits high-impact mountaineering only on authorised trails from 1 May to 31 October, and prohibits mountaineering outside the season or without registering. Confirm current conditions and access before setting out.
At Potrero de Yala Provincial Park, Resolution 101-SBDS/2025 prohibits taking soil, moss and plants and prohibits sport fishing and hunting.
Jujuy environment ministry says Resolution 117/MA-2020 prohibits bringing and using single-use plastics throughout the provincial protected-areas system.
